karsilastirma.baslik: Free to build. Free to download.
karsilastirma.aciklama: Most resume sites let you work in the editor for an hour, then ask for a card when you try to download. We don’t. Ever.

sablonlar.aciklama: Every template produces real text that applicant tracking systems can read. Tune colors, fonts and spacing as you like.

liste.metin: Add your experience, education and skills. Not sure what to write? Start from an example.
The preview updates as you type. Switch templates and your content stays put.
One click, no watermark. As many resumes and downloads as you like.
Missing sections, long bullets, date mistakes — flagged before you send.
Clean, selectable text that application systems can parse.

Resumes in several languages in one account; section titles follow the language.

liste.soru: Is it really free? Will I be charged later?
liste.cevap: Yes, completely free. No feature is paid, PDF download included, and we never ask for your credit card. Donations cover our costs.
No. The editor and PDF download work without one. An account is only for saving to the cloud, keeping versions and continuing on another device.

liste.soru: What is an ATS, and is my resume compatible?
liste.cevap: An ATS is software companies use to screen applications. Our templates output real text, not images, so these systems read your resume correctly.
Without an account your resume stays in your browser only. With an account it is stored on our server, accessible only to you.
Common in Turkey and Germany, discouraged in the US and UK. Choose your target country and the editor suggests what fits.

kisisel.eklerIpucu: Things like a driving licence or work permit. Don’t include an ID number, marital status or home address.

Editor.ozetIpucu: Ideal: 250–700 characters. Recruiters read this and your title in the first few seconds.
Editor.ozetOrnek: 3–4 sentences: who you are, years of experience, your 2–3 strongest skills and your goal.
Editor.ilgiOrnek: Keep it short; lead with what relates to the role.
Editor.maddeIpucu: One bullet per line. Wrap text in two asterisks for **bold**. Bullets that start with a verb and include numbers stand out.

aciklamalar.modern: Single column, accent-coloured headings, optional photo. The most balanced choice for most private-sector applications.
aciklamalar.ats: Single column, black and white, no icons. The layout applicant tracking systems read most reliably. No photo.
aciklamalar.zarif: Serif type, centred header, double rule. Makes a serious impression in public sector, academia, law and corporate roles.
aciklamalar.teknik: Coloured top band, skills as tags in two columns. Compact and easy to scan for software and technical roles.
aciklamalar.kenar: Two columns; photo, contact and skills in a coloured sidebar. Reading order for ATS starts with the main column.
